direct_answer: The immutable PDS44 revision and document ETag behavior are exact, but the deployed API fails the platform-truth gate. Method mismatch returns 404 instead of 405, 406 uses internal_error, safe 422 and server-timeout receipts are absent, request-ID parity is incomplete, only three of six identity domains are visible, invalid perspective silently substitutes published, and CLI history limits are ignored.

discovery_schema.capabilities: 200 with ETag, request ID, 4 nouns, and 16 commands
discovery_schema.openapi: 200 OpenAPI 3.1 with 151 paths, but examined paths document only 200/404/429 and Error does not require request_id

typed_error_matrix.500: partial: body typed; header parity unvisited

observations.request_ids: header/body parity 4/7; 500 body only; 422 and timeout unavailable
observations.identity_domains: 3/6 distinct deployed domains: document, revision, and ETag/cache; release, projection, and cycle absent
observations.conditional_document_get: 4/4: exact and wildcard 304/0; stale and absent 200/current

pagination_perspective.public_query: pass: stable total 669 and bounded limit/offset clamping

inferences: The 406 internal_error body follows the generic non-404 ErrorJSON mapping.
The history-limit defect is at the manifest/CLI seam because the controller reads limit while doc.history is not declared paginated.
Intermittent schema-list 500s resemble a prior overload incident, but their present root cause is unproven.
Any failed, blocked, proxy, or missing hard cell forbids this API unit from qualifying.
repair_seams: Return typed 405 and negotiation-specific 406 errors with request-ID parity.
Provide deterministic read-only fixtures for 422, controlled 500, and server timeout.
Require request_id and the full failure matrix in OpenAPI.
Expose release, projection, and cycle identities separately from document revision and ETag.
Reject invalid perspectives explicitly and forward history limits end to end.
risks: Method mismatch is falsely represented as document absence.
A deterministic 406 instructs clients to treat negotiation failure as an internal retryable error.
Invalid perspective silently changes caller intent.
Intermittent 500s can be erased by retries.
Release, projection, and cycle identity can be conflated with document revision or ETag.
Ignored history limits permit unexpectedly large payloads.
